Reason for Mistake: The Planner reversed the energy transformation, claiming heat is converted into motion and stored energy when jogging begins. In reality, the body’s stored chemical energy is converted into motion (kinetic energy) and heat due to muscle inefficiency. This conceptual error led to choosing option C instead of the correct option B, and the agent prematurely marked the task complete without proper validation.
